evals.prompt: Audit the supplied synthetic website/app evidence for human UX and AI/search AX, and provide an improvement plan. No implementation is authorized. Do not fetch the .invalid domains, run repo code, or send private data to services. Use only supplied files. Write UX_AX_REVIEW.md and ux-ax-findings.json to the assigned output directory. Target and evidence: evals/files/synthetic-demo.html and evals/files/web-evidence.md. Cover all requested aspects and respect the stated bot policy.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-scoped report; source schema price mismatch and unlabeled input supported; lab-only performance; optional llms absence not a blocker; intentional training denial preserved.
expectations: Writes both named artifacts and completes all 12 aspects with honest status/rationale.
Runs the bundled validator successfully and uses the required report headings.
Identifies JSON-LD 49 versus visible 19 as an observed structured-data mismatch with evidence.

Ends with a choice-of-IDs implementation offer and does not mutate supplied evidence.
Final response opens with `Result: PARTIAL` and names the cause (no screenshots or field data, so visual and field checks are not-tested), then lists only supported priorities.
Separates observed findings (each citing an E id and a plan task) from hypotheses and not-tested aspects, and ends with the choice-of-IDs question as the next decision.
